hypothesis: A CIA request has a six-CCK effective forwarding stage; clearing the source before Paula acknowledgment can distinguish in-flight propagation from persistent assertion.
competitor: Early INTREQ reflects a separate sampling or CPU phase; clearing ICR and acknowledging Paula cancels every stale request.
test: Compare nondestructive PB and destructive ICR reads followed by identical Paula PORTS/EXTER ack, NOP/EXG aperture and four request reads; five repeats, all calibration brackets exact. Latches24..39 must cover enabled pending ICR and clear ICR in preflight before hardware.

outcomes.ICR clear still permits delayed reassert: Constrain transport/in-flight stage and retain clear ordering for a causal forwarding model.
outcomes.ICR clear cancels while PB control reass: Constrain level/cancellation semantics; do not implement an uncancellable delay queue.

next_question: Can an already enabled CIA request survive source clear and Paula ack?
